newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $34.82 million of Treasury Bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $34.82 million of Treasury Bills.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius (central bank) sold all of the 700 million rupees (34.82 million dollars) of Treasury Bills tendered on Thursday, officials said.

They said at this week's auction, the bank sold 405.0 million rupees of 91-day, 127.0 million rupees of 182-day and 168.0 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 9.61 percent, 9.87 percent and 10.05 percent, respectively.
This week's effective bank rate has been posted at 10.01 percent per annum from 10.02 percent last week, the bank said.
Last week, the Bank of Mauritius sold 504.5 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day Treasury Bills with weighted yields of 9.65 percent, 9.67 percent and 9.95 percent, respectively.
